Why now

The quiet years are ending.

From 2026, e-commerce platforms report seller income to the Revenue Department directly. “I didn’t know” stops being a place to hide.

ภ.ง.ด.94Half year · Jul–Sep ภ.ง.ด.90Full year · Jan–Mar
Tax yearFollowing year
  • Two filings a year, not one Most sellers plan for March and miss the mid-year round entirely.
  • Two ways to deduct, and you choose Actual cost with every receipt kept, or the standard 40–60% rate for your activity. Choose wrong and you simply overpay.
  • ฿1,800,000 changes the job Cross it and VAT registration applies — then a VAT filing every month, not twice a year.

Filing periods, deduction rates and the platform-reporting change are carried from the project brief and the Revenue Code. Confirm the effective date and scope with the Revenue Department before any public use.

The gap

Everyone calculates. Nobody consolidates.

Already solved

  • Calculating personal income tax
  • Filing to the Revenue Department
  • Looking up what is deductible

Thai tax tools, iTAX among them, do this well. We are not trying to beat them at it.

Still manual, everywhere

  • Adding Shopee, Lazada, Facebook and LINE into one figure
  • Separating 40(8) income from the rest
  • Comparing actual cost against the standard rate
  • A warning before the ฿1.8M line, not after

Every tool we found still expects the seller to type this in. That is the wedge.

Based on our own review of the Thai tax tools available to sellers today. Competitive claims must be re-checked before public use.

Feasibility

Built first. Priced second.

The three assistants are not a plan. They run today — the screens you just saw came out of them.

Running today

  • Rule checks against Revenue Department guidance

Built and tested by the three of us.

Next

  • Sales-file import from Seller Centre

Roadmap. Not built, not announced.

Planned for

  • No official export API. The system reads an uploaded file from day one, so nothing waits on a platform partnership.
  • Tax guidance can be wrong. Every figure is labelled an estimate, not binding advice — check with an accountant or the Revenue Department before filing.

Marketplace connections to Shopee, Lazada, Facebook or LINE are roadmap. No partnership or integration is in place or announced.
